methodology.boundary: Fresh Node process launch through written Markdown pages and process exit
methodology.order: Sequential; rotate mode order each round; no concurrent benchmark jobs
methodology.cache: OS caches are uncontrolled. No-change incremental state and existing declarations are prepared separately.
methodology.included: Module imports, native CLI version check, complete project emit with type checking, library discovery, extraction, rendering, and writing
methodology.excluded: Dependency installation, package build, temporary config setup, result verification, cleanup, and the subsequent Vite/HTML site build
methodology.typedocOptions: Actual ardo/typedoc generator, plugin=[], excludeInternal/Private/Protected=true, sourceLinks=false; default breadcrumbs and hierarchy
methodology.output: The renderers produce different page trees and content. Output counts and bytes accompany each result; this is not feature parity or correctness evidence.
methodology.phases: Worker phase durations exclude Node startup. Parent wallMs includes process startup and exit; phase medians need not sum to the wall median.
